text: Managing a team is a challenging but rewarding responsibility. Good communication is the foundation of success, so leaders should share clear goals and listen to their team members. Delegation is equally important, as giving people the right tasks helps them grow and builds trust. Regular feedback, both positive and constructive, keeps everyone on track and shows that their work matters. Motivation comes from recognising effort and creating a supportive atmosphere where people feel valued. Finally, when disagreements arise, a good leader listens to both sides and helps find a fair solution. By developing these skills, managers can build a strong, happy and productive team.
